contributions.name: Cédric Bernadac
contributions.summary: Runs the Z Code game workshop and directed this production.

contributions.name: Z Code
contributions.summary: Designed the folding mechanic, built the inverse-unfolding level generator (every sheet solvable by construction) and the 12-level progression with BFS-proven pars, implemented the pure rules engine, the trilingual paper-and-ink interface (EN/FR/ES), the audio and the tests, and verified the published game in the public reader.

contributions.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
contributions.summary: Reviewed the rules wording (size constraint added, clearer win condition) and the small-screen readability of the ink-and-paper palette; suggestions were selectively applied by Z Code.
